name: Caro-Kann Defence
goal: As Black against 1.e4, you can play the Caro-Kann: support d5 with c6, develop the light-squared bishop early, and keep a solid position.
intro: The Caro-Kann answers 1.e4 with 1...c6 and then ...d5. The c-pawn backs up the d-pawn, so Black gets a firm hold in the centre. Unlike the French Defence (1...e6), it leaves the road open for the light-squared bishop, which comes out early. The result is a solid position with few weak points for White to attack.

parts.title: Bishop out before the pawns close
parts.keyIdea: Back up ...d5 with the c-pawn, and bring the light-squared bishop out before ...e6 shuts it in.
parts.text: You are Black, and White opens with 1.e4. The line is the Classical Variation as Lichess's list of openings names it. At each move, ask what it does for your centre and your pieces, and what White is threatening.
parts.line: e4 c6 d4 d5 Nc3 dxe4 Nxe4 Bf5 Ng3 Bg6 h4 h6 Nf3 Nd7

notes.text: 1...c6 looks quiet, but it prepares 2...d5 with a pawn ready to take back on d5. Unlike 1...e6, it keeps the diagonal of your light-squared bishop open, so that bishop can come out early.
White has two pawns in the centre. 2...d5 challenges the e4 pawn at once, and if White swaps with 3.exd5, you take back with the c-pawn and still have a pawn in the centre.
3.Nc3 guards e4. Take it anyway: 3...dxe4 removes White's e-pawn, and after the knight takes back, your next move can attack it.
4...Bf5 is the Classical Variation. The bishop comes out before ...e6 can shut it in, and it attacks the knight on e4. 4...Nd7 and 4...Nf6 are the other main moves.
5.Ng3 attacks your bishop. 5...Bg6 keeps it on the same diagonal, outside your pawns, where it still looks into White's camp at d3 and c2.
6.h4 threatens 7.h5, and then the bishop on g6 would have no good square left, because your own pawn on h7 blocks its way back. 6...h6 makes room: after h5, the bishop can drop back to h7.
White's knight would like to jump to e5 and hit your bishop. 7...Nd7 guards e5, so a knight that lands there can be taken. Next come ...e6, ...Ngf6 and the dark-squared bishop, and then you castle.
